rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for crying out or loudly saying something with strong emotion.

example.english: When I saw the fireworks, I couldn't help but exclaim, “They’re beautiful!”
example.traditional: 見到煙花嗰刻，我忍唔住大叫：「好靚呀！」
example.jyutping: gin3 dou2 jin1 faa1 go2 hak1 ngo5 jan2 m4 zyu6 daai6 giu3 hou2 leng3 aa1

rows.note: Use this for an exclamation caused specifically by surprise or alarm, especially in more formal or written contexts.

example.english: As the fire suddenly spread, everyone could not help but exclaim, “Get out quickly!”
example.traditional: 火勢突然蔓延，眾人不禁驚呼：「快啲離開！」
example.jyutping: fo2 sai3 dat6 jin4 maan6 jin4 zung3 jan4 bat1 gam1 ging1 fu1 faai3 di1 lei4 hoi1

rows.note: Use this when the words come out suddenly and involuntarily, whether or not the speaker is loud.

example.english: I had no time to think and could only exclaim, “Huh, really?”
example.traditional: 聽到個消息，我一時緊張，脫口而出：「吓，真㗎？」
example.jyutping: teng1 dou3 go3 siu1 sik1 ngo5 jat1 si4 gan2 zoeng1 tyut3 hau2 ji4 ceot1 haa2 zan1 gaa3
